Image 1 is a photo of a room. Images 2 to 10 are products, one photo each:
image 2: tall solid wood bookcase, 90 cm wide, 2 units
image 3: cantilever bentwood leather lounge armchair, size unknown
image 4: swing-arm floor lamp with drum shade, size unknown
image 5: round two-tier side table, size unknown
image 6: natural sheepskin rug, size unknown
image 7: cable-knit throw blanket, size unknown
image 8: rust red linen-look cushion, size unknown
image 9: pair of linen curtains, size unknown
image 10: braided money tree houseplant, size unknown

The person asked for this room: "Quiero transformar este cuarto en un rincón de lectura acogedor. Lo principal es una biblioteca grande y alta, de madera oscura como el piso, contra la pared de la izquierda, que ocupe buena parte de esa pared y donde entren muchos libros. Junto a la ventana, un sillón cómodo para leer con una lámpara de pie al lado y una mesita para apoyar el café. En el piso, una alfombra redonda clara. Que todo se sienta cálido, con maderas y textiles naturales."

Furnish the room in image 1 with these products, as an interior designer would for that request. You decide where each product goes and how the room is arranged. Use every product: one of each, or as many as its line says ("2 units": two of it).

Keep image 1 as it is: the same framing and camera, walls, floor, ceiling, windows and light. Only add the products, each with the design, proportions, colors and materials of its photo, at its real size against the room, lit like the room. The result must look like a real photograph.
